td36-001.concept: Blue parks in the top gap so an L can shift and drop; red waits for the cleared lane.
td36-001.dependency_description: Red's east exit is blocked until blue leaves the lane and the L shifts right. Counterfactual walls on those pieces change red's solo length.
td36-001.human_test_notes: Not run. Desktop start-position screenshot only.

td36-002.concept: A three-cell bar and an L share a corridor; yellow is trapped until the bar drops.
td36-002.dependency_description: The L can leave first. The bar must then drop before yellow and the vertical red can reach their gates.
td36-002.human_test_notes: Not run. Desktop start-position screenshot only. The L has a clear first exit; remaining work is the bar.

td36-003.concept: Two eastbound and two westbound tiles pass through one pocket.
td36-003.dependency_description: Yellow must store in the pocket so red and blue can cross, then orange stores so they can leave east. Removing the pocket walls collapses the pass.
td36-003.human_test_notes: Not run. Desktop start-position screenshot only.

td36-004.concept: Three eastbound tiles meet two westbound tiles on a longer siding.
td36-004.dependency_description: The extra eastbound tile adds a restore-and-cross cycle after the first westbound exit.
td36-004.human_test_notes: Not run. Desktop start-position screenshot only.

td36-005.concept: Three versus three on a nine-cell track with one pocket.
td36-005.dependency_description: Each westbound tile is stored once while the eastbound file is driven past, then restored. Three such cycles.
td36-005.human_test_notes: Not run. Desktop start-position screenshot only.

td36-006.concept: Two eastbound tiles thread a three-tile westbound file.
td36-006.dependency_description: Blue parks first so two westbound tiles can leave, then red parks so blue can finish east.
td36-006.human_test_notes: Not run. Desktop start-position screenshot only.

td36-007.concept: Yellow already occupies the only pocket at the start.
td36-007.dependency_description: The eastbound file must vacate the mouth of the pocket before yellow can re-enter the track and leave west.
td36-007.human_test_notes: Not run. Desktop start-position screenshot only.

td36-008.concept: Green starts in the pocket, so two eastbound tiles wait on the track.
td36-008.dependency_description: Green must leave the pocket onto the track before the same three-cycle shuttle as td36-005 can begin, adding two setup actions.
td36-008.human_test_notes: Not run. Desktop start-position screenshot only.

td36-009.concept: A T-tetromino sits above an L. The T only fits a three-column floor gate after the L and two keys leave.
td36-009.why_challenging: The T cannot use a one-cell door. The player has to clear the L's two-row side gate and move a key off the drop column before the T can fall.
td36-009.dependency_description: Proven: red (T) is blocked by blue, yellow, and orange. Blue is blocked by yellow. Counterfactual walls change those solo lengths.
td36-009.human_test_notes: Not run. Estimated Easy from length 5 only; that is not a human measurement.

td36-010.concept: A horizontal I-tromino must slide two columns onto a three-wide floor gate. An L occupies the slide.
td36-010.why_challenging: A three-wide bar cannot exit a one-cell door. The L has to leave the right edge first, then the bar slides onto the gate span and drops past a key.
td36-010.dependency_description: Proven: the bar is blocked by the L and by orange. Only one piece meets the blocked-by counterfactual, so genuine_multi_piece is false.
td36-010.human_test_notes: Not run. Estimated Easy from length 5 only; that is not a human measurement.

td36-011.concept: A Z-tetromino needs floor columns 1-3. A vertical I-tromino occupies column 3 and leaves through a three-row side gate.
td36-011.why_challenging: The Z's floor span is plugged by a tall post that cannot drop through the Z's gate. The post must leave sideways, then the L and a key clear the remaining floor cells.
td36-011.dependency_description: Proven: the Z is blocked by the post, the L, and orange. Orange is blocked by the post.
td36-011.human_test_notes: Not run. Length 4 is below the Easy 5-10 action band. Human difficulty unmeasured.

td36-012.concept: A T starts over columns 0-2. Its floor gate is columns 2-4, so it must slide before it can drop. An L occupies that slide.
td36-012.why_challenging: Gate alignment is the puzzle: the T's silhouette already matches a three-wide door, but not the door it starts above. Sliding onto the gate is illegal until the L leaves.
td36-012.dependency_description: Proven: the T is blocked by the L, yellow, and orange. One blocked piece, so genuine_multi_piece is false.
td36-012.human_test_notes: Not run. Estimated Easy from length 5 only; that is not a human measurement.

td36-013.concept: A T is stacked on an S. The S leaves through a two-row side gate so the T can inherit the floor.
td36-013.why_challenging: Two wide shapes share the same columns. The S cannot use the floor; it has to exit sideways. The L under the S has to duck for a key, then return to its own two-row gate.
td36-013.dependency_description: Proven: the T is blocked by the S, the L, and yellow. The L is blocked by the S and yellow.
td36-013.human_test_notes: Not run. Estimated Easy from length 6 only; stacking may feel harder. Unmeasured.

td36-014.concept: A T must slide onto columns 2-4. A vertical I-tetromino occupies column 3 and drops through a one-column floor gate.
td36-014.why_challenging: Two different floor-gate widths: the post uses a 1-cell door the T cannot fit. The T's 3-cell door sits under the post, so the post has to drop first.
td36-014.dependency_description: Proven: the T is blocked by the post and by yellow.
td36-014.human_test_notes: Not run. Estimated Easy from length 5 only; that is not a human measurement.

td36-015.concept: A T needs columns 1-3 on the floor. A domino covers 1-2 and an L occupies the right side of that landing.
td36-015.why_challenging: A two-cell plug and an L together occupy the T's only legal floor span. The domino uses a one-cell side door the T cannot use.
td36-015.dependency_description: Proven: the T is blocked by the L, the domino, and yellow. Only one blocked piece, so genuine_multi_piece is false.
td36-015.human_test_notes: Not run. Length 4 is below the Easy 5-10 action band. Human difficulty unmeasured.

td36-016.concept: A five-cell plus sits on an L and an S. Both must leave sideways so the plus can take a three-column floor gate.
td36-016.why_challenging: The plus is 3×3 and only fits the floor well. The S has to park up, let a key out, then return to a two-row side gate. That is a real move-and-restore, not a one-way clear.
td36-016.dependency_description: Proven: the plus is blocked by the L and the S. The S is delayed by yellow. The key is blocked by the L and the S.
td36-016.human_test_notes: Not run. Estimated Easy from length 6 only; restore move may feel harder. Unmeasured.
